_about: The token tree build_tokens.py turns into tokens.json. endel.io and app.endel.io declare named :root vars (a neutral ramp, two declared accents the signed-out pages never paint, the 12-column grid and the apercuPro type scale); "var" leaves resolve through those declarations, "value" leaves are measured computed styles. Both hosts paint one dark theme, so the semantic set lands in `dark`.

black.description: The pure black every page paints on (#000, body's own fill and the header scrim's base).

800.description: #191919: card fills (accordion rows, the mini-player pill, the timer sheet) and the footer hairline.

700.description: #262626: the default fill of every button and pill (Try Today, Sign In, Continue, OAuth, the scenario pills).

500.description: #808080: field borders, the hover/pressed fill of gray-2 buttons, the link focus ring, the volume track's empty half.

300.description: #bfbfbf: muted text (footer headings and legal links, the accordion answer, the mini-player's time).

200.description: #e0e0e0: the lightest grey, the FREEMIUM account chip's label.

white.description: #fff: text, strong borders (focused fields, the Unlock and Continue borders), the play button's fill.

green.description: #82d133, declared on both hosts' :root; nothing on the captured signed-out routes paints it.

orange.description: #ff7a00, declared on both hosts' :root; nothing on the captured signed-out routes paints it.

bright.description: #58ff5d, declared on app.endel.io's :root only; nothing on the captured signed-out routes paints it.

brightHover.description: #3ee843, the hover state of --color-accent-green, declared on app.endel.io's :root only.

h3.description: 36px smaller headings — also the mobile display size (m-hero-title computes 36px).

h4.description: 28px minor headings and the player title.

text1.description: 22px lead text and big links/buttons (nav items, Try Now, button labels).

text3.description: 16px base text and small button labels (header buttons).

sans.source: computed fontFamily of page-ground default (raw/components-computed.json); the apercuPro faces are @font-face declarations in the site and app bundles (fonts in raw/css-vars.json)
sans.description: apercuPro plus the metric-matched 'apercuPro Fallback' (a local Arial face with override descriptors), the stack every captured marketing node uses.

appSans.source: computed fontFamily of login-card default (raw/components-computed.json); the apercuPro faces are @font-face declarations in the site and app bundles (fonts in raw/css-vars.json)
appSans.description: apercuProRegular plus its metric-matched fallback — the web app's own body face (the app bundle declares a separate apercuProRegular @font-face at weight 400).

appMedium.source: computed textStyle.fontFamily of banner default (raw/components-computed.json); the apercuPro faces are @font-face declarations in the site and app bundles (fonts in raw/css-vars.json)
appMedium.description: apercuProMedium plus its fallback — the app's second declared face (weight 500); the banner's promo text is set in it even though its computed fontWeight reads 400.

gutter.description: The 64px side gutter inside the 1280px column.

1.description: The width of 1 column at the 1280px container (74px).

2.description: The width of 2 columns at the 1280px container (172px).

3.description: The width of 3 columns at the 1280px container (270px).

4.description: The width of 4 columns at the 1280px container (368px).

5.description: The width of 5 columns at the 1280px container (466px).

6.description: The width of 6 columns at the 1280px container (564px).

7.description: The width of 7 columns at the 1280px container (662px).

8.description: The width of 8 columns at the 1280px container (760px).

9.description: The width of 9 columns at the 1280px container (858px).

10.description: The width of 10 columns at the 1280px container (956px).

11.description: The width of 11 columns at the 1280px container (1054px).

12.description: The width of 12 columns at the 1280px container (1152px).

titleTracking.description: The 0.35px tracking on the display sizes (h1-h3 share it).

linkHover.description: Links keep their colour on hover — only an underline paints (the footer's legal line additionally steps #bfbfbf to white).

glowColour.description: The Try Today button keeps its white 15px glow through hover.

sliderBase.description: The volume slider's own colour #101010 (the track paints a white/gray-3 gradient over it).

mobileMenuLabel.description: The 12px label on the mobile Menu button.

glow.description: The white 0 0 15px glow on the Try Today button (kept through hover and press).

focusRing.description: The product's keyboard focus ring on buttons: a #666666 6px spread shadow.

focusRingLink.description: The focus ring on plain links and tiles: a #808080 4px spread shadow.

basic.description: The 12px corner of buttons, fields, accordion rows and the mobile menu button (the bundle's border-radius-basic).

full.description: The 100px pill/circle corner (play and transport buttons, scenario pills, the mini-player pill; the bundle's border-radius-full).

sheet.description: The 20px top corner of the player's bottom Explore sheet (20px 20px 0 0).

card.description: The 24px corner of the explore carousel banner.

dialog.description: The 32px corner of the timer sheet.

hover.description: The 200ms background/border transition on every button and accordion row.

sheet.source: declared slide-in-out/slide-out transition in the app bundle's CSSOM (raw/components-computed.json _meta.sheets)
sheet.description: The 300ms slide of the timer sheet and the mobile menu.

standard.description: Plain ease on the hover transitions.

sheetIn.source: declared .slide-in-out-enter animation in the app bundle's CSSOM (raw/components-computed.json _meta.sheets)

sheetOut.source: declared .slide-in-out-exit animation in the app bundle's CSSOM (raw/components-computed.json _meta.sheets)

headerScrim.description: The fade the fixed header paints over scrolled content.

declaredScrim.source: declared --color-gradient-1 on :root (raw/css-vars.json); where it mounts was not identified on the captured routes

page.description: The pure black every captured route paints on (body's own fill).
page.source: computed backgroundColor of page-ground default (raw/components-computed.json); same value as core.color.neutral.black

text.description: The display type's white; all captured text is white or a grey.
text.source: computed color of hero-title default (raw/components-computed.json); same value as core.color.neutral.white

muted.description: Secondary text: footer legal links, accordion answers, the mini-player's time (#bfbfbf on the text node).
muted.source: computed textStyle.color of footer-legal default (raw/components-computed.json); same value as core.color.neutral.300

faint.description: The lightest text grey, the FREEMIUM account chip's label (#e0e0e0).
faint.source: computed textStyle.color of app-header default (raw/components-computed.json); same value as core.color.neutral.200

surface.description: The card fill, #191919 (accordion rows, the mini-player pill, the timer sheet).
surface.source: computed backgroundColor of accordion-title default (raw/components-computed.json); same value as core.color.neutral.800

surfaceRaised.description: The control fill, #262626 (every button and pill at rest).
surfaceRaised.source: computed backgroundColor of btn-signin default (raw/components-computed.json); same value as core.color.neutral.700

fillHover.description: The hover and pressed fill of gray-2 controls, #808080.
fillHover.source: computed backgroundColor of btn-signin hover (raw/components-computed.json); same value as core.color.neutral.500

border.source: computed borderTopColor of input-email-login default (raw/components-computed.json); same value as core.color.neutral.500

borderStrong.description: The focused-field and primary-action border, pure white.
borderStrong.source: computed borderTopColor of input-email-login focused (raw/components-computed.json); same value as core.color.neutral.white

borderSubtle.description: The 1px hairline under the footer columns, #191919.
borderSubtle.source: computed paint.2.border of footer default (raw/components-computed.json); same value as core.color.neutral.800

bar.description: The player header's inner bar, #2b2b2b, a grey between gray-2 and gray-3 that no var names.

scrim.description: The modal overlay, rgba(0,0,0,0.8), behind the timer sheet.

focus.description: The keyboard focus ring's colour #666666, painted as a 6px spread shadow (the UA outline is suppressed).

chipOutline.description: The carousel banner's inset outline, rgba(255,255,255,0.15).

onAccent.description: Text on a white fill inside the banner (the SPECIAL OFFER tag chip), black.
onAccent.source: computed textStyle.color of banner default (raw/components-computed.json); same value as core.color.neutral.black

heightNav.description: Header buttons are 44px (Try Today, Sign In).

height.description: The 56px large controls (Set Timer, Continue, OAuth, scenario pills, transport buttons).

border.description: Every button and field carries a 2px border (often painted its own fill colour).

width.description: The login field and card are 564px wide, exactly --cols-6.
The footer newsletter field is 466px wide, exactly --cols-5 (466x56).
A soundscape row (and the carousel banner) is 956px, exactly --cols-10.
An FAQ row spans the full grid, 1152px = --cols-12.
The volume slider is 129px wide, 5px tall.
A promo row in the open mobile menu, 326px.
